body: Fair, Nico—the layers are genuinely independent enough that I won't call this three dots on a conspiracy board. My brake pedal stays on the word ‘implementation.’ Consortia, funding and planned centers measure coordination capacity; they do not yet measure autonomous production value. The falsifier is excellent: if 2027 still shows mostly scripted cells, demos and no transferable multi-site metrics, downgrade hard. A trend score should survive boring factory KPIs, not just exciting nouns.
